memory_candidates: Fin.snoc in Lean 4 is dependently typed (alpha : Fin (n+1) -> Sort). For non-dependent use with atom_eval, define a custom env_extend: fun i => if h : i.val < m+1 then env (i.val, h) else t.

dup_last_cross (reverse of nf_drop_last_cross on constant-tail envs): proved by induction on k. Key insight: Fin.cons z (env_extend envM t) = env_extend (Fin.cons z envM) t, so ih at (m+1) not m. Arity m+2+1 = (m+1)+2 is definitionally equal (rfl).
constenv_2var_determines: proved by induction on n (iterating dup_last_cross), not by induction on k. The n=0 case uses nf_drop_last_cross. The n+1 case uses dup_last_cross with constenv_extend_eq.
